chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel, from Muhammad Bin Marwan who said:
Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'What prevented Meysam, may Allah have Mercy on him, from the dissimulation (Taqiyya)?'
By Allah, he had known that this Verse was Revealed regarding Ammar and his companions: 'except the one who is compelled while his heart is at rest on account of faith'.

key_terms.إِلَى مَنْ أُكْرِهَ: Except the one who is compelled; the condition of external force in the Quranic verse.
key_terms.التَّقِيَّة: Dissimulation; the practice of concealing one's faith or beliefs under pressure or danger.
key_terms.عَمَّار: Ammar ibn Yasir; a prominent companion known for his Taqiyya during persecution.
key_terms.قَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ: His heart is at rest; the condition of internal firmness in faith despite external compulsion.
key_terms.مِيثَم: Meysam; a companion of the Imams mentioned in this narration.

ai.seo_question: Why did Meysam not practice Taqiyya if the verse of compulsion applied to him?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq clarifies that Meysam’s failure to practice Taqiyya stemmed not from ignorance, but from his precise understanding that the verse of Ammar ibn Yasir (16:106) required both external compulsion and internal steadfastness of heart. This distinction underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the condition of 'Iqraan' (professing with the tongue while the heart remains firm) as the threshold for permissible dissimulation during times of persecution.

en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel, from Muhammad Bin Marwan who said,

By Allahazwj, he had known that this Verse was Revealed regarding Ammar and his companions [16:106] except the one who is compelled while his heart is at rest on account of faith’.
en.sarwar: 15. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil from Muhammad ibn Marwan who has said the following: “Once
abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) said to me, ‘What was it that prevented Maytham (may Allah grant him blessings) from al-Taqiyyah?’
1 He by Allah knew that this verse of the Holy Quran was revealed about ‘Ammar and his people, ‘. . . unless he is forced, but his heart is confident with belief. . . .’”( 16 : 106 )
